g.text: 100 people. Green: actually happy (30). Amber ring: smiling, and correctly spotted by a 99 %-accurate smile detector (42).

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #dc2626

g.text: Of the 42 it flags as 'happy', 21 are. The camera made no mistake: half of all smiles are not joy.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #888888

g.text: (illustrative rates: people smile 70 % of the time when happy, 30 % of the time when not)
